comment: The Documentation page's contents (docs.js) - in c³ and on the website (make site). A group lists guides (id: www/docs/<id>.html, written for the reader from the Markdown in 'from') and repositories (repo: opens it on GitHub). 'from' is where a guide's facts come from, 'at' the commit of that repository it was last brought up to date with - tools/docsStale.py lists the guides whose sources changed since. 'privateGroup': the private repositories of that kind the user can read are added to it, in c³ only (GET /api/repos/private).
